meta.description: Ability id to name lookup for the save viewer
meta.grid_rule: ability_id = (byte - 0x38) * 8 + bit, most significant bit first
meta.status_note: Names are documented community data, not extracted from the game's asset tables. 'ambiguous' marks ids where the two community sources disagree.
